title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller
£27,000 - £30,000
Derby/Nottingham border
Temporary 3-6 months
Office-based

We're looking for an experienced Credit Controller to join a busy finance team on a temporary basis for an initial 3-6 months. The location is well suited to candidates commuting from either the Nottingham or Derby area.

This is a hands-on Credit Control position focused on getting the cash in. You'll manage an allocated portfolio of customer accounts, monitor aged debt, proactively chase outstanding invoices and work with internal teams and customers to resolve anything holding up payment.

The role will include:
- Managing an allocated portfolio of customer accounts
- Monitoring aged debt and prioritising outstanding balances
- Chasing overdue invoices by phone, email and written correspondence
- Having regular conversations with customers to secure payment
- Investigating and resolving invoice, pricing and payment queries
- Liaising with Sales, Customer Service and Operations to resolve issues
- Reconciling customer accounts and allocating incoming payments
- Downloading and posting cash receipts
- Running and sending customer statements
- Escalating overdue or high-risk accounts where required
- Supporting credit checks and the opening of new customer accounts
- Reviewing customer accounts and highlighting potential credit risks
- Producing and reviewing aged debt reports
- Reporting collection issues and higher-risk accounts to the Credit Manager
- Supporting month-end and year-end finance processes
- Working with external collection agencies or solicitors where required
- Providing cover for colleagues during periods of absence

About you:
- Previous experience in Credit Control, Accounts Receivable or a similar finance role
- Confident speaking to customers and chasing outstanding payments
- Strong communication and negotiation skills
- Comfortable dealing with queries and following issues through to resolution
- Good numerical and analytical ability
- Strong organisation skills and the ability to manage your own workload
- Good Excel skills - advanced Excel would be useful, but isn't essential
- Comfortable working with finance systems and able to pick up new systems quickly
- A proactive approach, with the persistence to keep chasing when payment isn't forthcoming

The most important thing for this role is a genuine focus on cash collection. You'll need to be comfortable picking up the phone, having those payment conversations and taking ownership of your ledger rather than waiting for problems to resolve themselves.

The position is office-based, working either 8:30am-4:30pm or 9:00am-5:00pm.

This is an initial 3-6 month temporary contract, with the longer-term requirement still to be determined, based on performance.

If you're an experienced Credit Controller looking for a new opportunity and enjoy a role where you can make a real impact on cash flow, we'd like to hear from you.

This is a rewarding opportunity to play a vital role in supporting our patients and clinical team, ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of our practice. The ideal candidate will have excellent communication and organisational skills, be confident multitasking in a busy environment, and remain calm and professional under pressure. Previous GP practice experience is desirable. Flexibility to cover both morning (8:00am2:00pm) and afternoon (12:30pm6:30pm) shifts is essential. If you are a compassionate team player who takes pride in delivering excellent patient care, we would love to hear from you! Key Responsibilities Appointments: Maintain the electronic appointment system, arrange appointments with appropriate clinicians, manage urgent requests, record home visit requests and process urgent calls to the on-call doctor in line with practice protocols. Patient Care: Welcome patients and visitors professionally, answer telephone calls, respond to enquiries, relay messages accurately, keep patients informed of delays, explain practice procedures, process repeat prescription requests, arrange sample collection and obtain test results when required. Maintain tidy reception and waiting areas. Administration: Maintain accurate paper and electronic patient records, scan and file correspondence, enter clinical data using appropriate read codes, prepare clinical rooms, replenish supplies, maintain patient information materials, record income, issue receipts and update relevant records and status boards. Teamwork and Practice Operations: Work flexibly to provide reception cover, attend training and support communication across the primary healthcare team. Open and prepare the surgery each morning, deactivate the alarm and secure the premises and activate the alarm at the end of the day. Confidentiality: Comply with data protection legislation and Caldicott principles when handling confidential patient information. Other Duties: Undertake additional reasonable duties to meet the changing needs of the practice, including providing cover for administrative colleagues when required. MEDICAL RECEPTIONIST JOB DESCRIPTION Responsible to: Assistant Practice Manager Accountable to: Practice Manager JOB PURPOSE: To provide & maintain a high standard of reception & administrative support to the practice.To treat every patient as an individual and to be courteous, helpful and accurate in communication and promote the corporate image of the practice. KEY RESULT AREAS & MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Maintain the electronic appointments system: Ensure the efficiency of the appointment system, according to practice guidelines. Manage the appointment system so that patients are able to see the appropriate clinician in appropriate time and manner. Ensure that patients without appointments, but who need to be seen urgently are seen in accordance with current protocol. Record home visits requests for GPs / district nurses. Process urgent house calls to the on-call Doctor, in line with practice protocol. 2. Client care: Meet & greet patients & visitors to the practice with courtesy and a smile; maintaining a professional corporate image at all times. Communicate with patients & the primary care team in a pleasant and helpful manner. Respond to all queries and requests for assistance from patients and visitors. Answer telephone calls within 5 seconds where possible and respond to queries promptly. Take messages and ensure that Information is passed on accurately and with the appropriate urgency. Monitor the flow of patients into consulting and treatment rooms; keeping patients informed, with apologies if necessary, of any possible delays in the appointments system. Explain Practice arrangements to new patients and temporary residents. Receive requests for repeat prescriptions and pass on for processing. Ensure samples received from patients are collected & handed to the courier each day. Ensure reception and waiting areas are kept clean and tidy. When required, Contact external Health Care providers for test results for Doctors and patients. 3. Administration: Retrieve and re-file records as required (including electronic patient records); making sure that all records are available for urgent consultations and visits. Maintain patient paper & computer records; including sorting, filing, scanning & copying. Collect and enter data on to the clinical system, using appropriate read codes. Ensure that all correspondence, reports and results are sorted in chronological order on day of receipt for scanning. Check all clinical rooms at the start/end of each surgery ensuring that they are kept clean and tidy, including bed rolls and computers are turned off/on. Check and stock up clinical rooms with appropriate forms/ stationery needed. Maintain stocks of stationery & patient information on reception i.e. maternity packs, practice information leaflet, newsletter, appointments slips, new patient packs, etc. Recording all income & issuing receipts to patients. Update status board with births, deaths and admissions and record on EPR. 4. Team work: Work flexibly with colleagues to cover the opening hours of the surgery. Attend training sessions where relevant to work. Facilitate the communication between other members of the Primary Health Care Team. Open up the surgery in the morning including de-activating the alarm and preparing for the days work. Activate the surgery alarm and ensure the security of the building on leaving. 5. Ensure compliance with Data Protection & Caldicott requirements. 6. Any other duties as deemed necessary bearing in mind the ever-changing needs within the Practice. Including relief cover for other administration staff as required CONFIDENTIALITY & DATA PROTECTION Patients entrust us with, or allow us to gather sensitive information to their health & other matters. They do so in confidence & have the right to expect that staff will respect their privacy & act accordingly. In performance of the duties in this job description, the post holder will have access to confidential information relating to patients and their carers, practice staff & other healthcare workers and also access to information relating to the practice as a business organisation. All such information from any source is to be regarded as strictly confidential.Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other healthcare workers or the business of the practice may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with the practice policies & procedures relating to confidentiality & the protection of personal & sensitive data.You are required to exercise due consideration in the way you use such information & should not act in any way, which might be prejudicial to the Practices interests.The practice is registered under the Data Protection Act. You must not at any time use the personal data held by the practice for a purpose not described in the register entry or disclose such information to a third party. EQUALITY & DIVERSITY The post holder will support the equality, diversity & rights of patients, carers & colleagues to include: Acting in a way which recognises the importance of peoples rights, interpreting them in a way which is consistent with practice procedures & policies & in line with current legislation. Respecting privacy, dignity, needs & beliefs of patients, carers & colleagues. Behaving in a manner which is welcoming to, and of the individual is non-judgmental & respects their circumstances, feelings & priorities.

title: Clinic Receptionist and Administration Officer
company: University Hospitals of Derby and Burton NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: University Hospitals of Derby and Burton NHS Foundation Trust
description: To provide a comprehensive Outpatient Administration and Main Reception service to the Ilkeston site. This will be to support University Hospitals of Derby and Burton and Derbyshire Community Health Services. To provide a 7-day rostered service to the Community Diagnostic Centre which will include MRI, CT, Ultrasound and Point Of Care Testing. To provide administrative support to the Health Records Department. This involves working closely and communicating effectively with a Multidisciplinary teams using initiative, tact, and diplomacy. We have an opportunity for 12 hour post working Saturdays and Sundays on Am and PM roster . This will be a 7am to 7pm service. Flexibility will paramount to this role and for the right candidates we can offer full day shifts or split shifts. You will be joining an already established team who have patient care and outcomes at the heart of everything they do. We offer an excellent working package and free on site parking. This role will require the successful candidate to occasionally work across our local community sites. Work on own initiative to ensure the work allocated to the post holder is organised to ensure all deadlines are met, and standards are maintained. To record data, using Lorenzo, SystmOne and the room booking software. To record and update case note folder location details on the case note tracking system. To prepare the contents of case notes in accordance with the case note maintenance policy and prepare items for scanning onto the Patient Administration System (PAS) ensuring information is coded in order to ensure that data can be identified and retrieved as and when required. Provide a courteous and efficient reception service to all Patients attending the hospital, observing confidentiality, overcoming barriers of language and disability etc. Make follow up appointments for outpatients using the PAS system, generating letters, and completing Outpatients Outcomes and Clinical Coding outcomes on the database as required for the Trust Data collection purposes. Ensure the 18-week RTT (referral to treatment) end date is captured on PAS system so that the Trust meets the Government targets. To provide a friendly, helpful, and professional reception service, duties to include cash handling and banking, receipt and distribution of incoming mail, franking and posting. Closing date of applications: 1 November 2026 Date of interview: 11 November 2026 Please see attached Job description and Person Specification. To apply please click APPLY FOR THIS JOB this link will take you to the TRAC Recruitment Site. You will need to register if you do not already have an account. UHDB is committed to fair and transparent recruitment. We welcome authentic applications that reflect your own skills, experience and motivations for the role. While we understand that candidates may use AI tools for grammar, formatting or accessibility purposes, applications that appear to be substantially AIgenerated may be subject to additional review. If this applies to your submission, we will let you know and may ask for clarification. Please ensure your application accurately represents your experience and is written in your own words. Please note this position is not eligible for sponsorship. Applicants must be able to demonstrate an existing and ongoing right to work in the UK for the duration of the contract without sponsorship from the Trust. Your application (for shortlisting purposes) is assessed based on the Person Specification in the job advert (below).

title: Medical Receptionist
description: Do you love helping people? Are you friendly, organised and passionate about providing excellent patient care? Were looking for an enthusiastic and driven receptionist to join our team at Village surgery, helping us deliver a welcoming, supportive and efficient service to our patients. Our reception team is often the first point of contact for patients, making this a vital role in ensuring everyone receives the care, guidance and support they need. If you enjoy working with people, thrive in a busy environment and want to make a real difference in your community, wed love to hear from you! As a GP Receptionist, no two days will be quite the same! Your key responsibilities will include: This is a 30-hour-per-week position , with shifts scheduled Monday to Friday between 7:30 am and 8:00 pm .Flexibility is essential. You must also be available to cover scheduled overtime and occasional short-notice staff absences. Providing a friendly, professional and approachable first point of contact, both face-to-face and over the telephone. Receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way Undertake a variety of administrative duties to assist in the smooth running of the practice Facilitate effective communication between patients, members of the primary health care team, secondary care and other associated healthcare agencies Supporting colleagues and helping us maintain the high standards of care our patients deserve Must be able to work a variety of shifts Monday to Friday between the hours of 7.30 am and 8.00 pm, you must also be available to cover scheduled over time and last minute staff absence. The duties and responsibilities to be undertaken by members of the practice administration team may include any or all of the items in the following list. Duties may be varied from time to time under the direction of the senior receptionist/practice manager, dependent on current and evolving practice workload and staffing levels: Opening up/locking up of practice premises and maintaining security in accordance with practice protocols Maintaining and monitoring the practice appointments system Processing personal and telephone requests for appointments, visits and telephone consultations, and ensuring callers are signposted to the appropriate healthcare professionals Processing and distributing incoming (and outgoing) mail Taking messages and passing on information Filing and retrieving paperwork Processing repeat prescriptions in accordance with practice guidelines Computer data entry/data allocation and collation; processing and recording information in accordance with practice procedures Initiating contact with and responding to requests from patients, other team members and associated healthcare agencies and providers Clearing and re-stocking of consulting rooms as required Providing clerical assistance to practice staff as required from time to time, including word/data processing, filing, photocopying and scanning Dealing with clinical waste Keeping the reception area, notice-boards and leaflet dispensers tidy and free from obstructions and clutter
